structured.approach: I followed DE-05 in the data-engineering-steps skill. First I read both contracted inputs: task.components at 7cb32bd and the feature override of org.data_model at e8afce8. I also read the organisation's baseline org/org.data_model.md so I could compare the model before and after the feature. I used context_get to read the approved feat.design as background, which gives a receipt for its record contracts (DC-1, DC-2, B1.2 to B1.4, DD-6, DD-7, NF-4). Every statement about the ap_pipeline code rests on the step's tool view (tool:repo) alone, and the output makes no claim about a CI run. The output covers: the change to the source system, the Invoice entity before and after, the paid_date attribute specification, the new reject reason, the derived delay-history view, a knowledge-graph diagram, compatibility, and a column-to-attribute handover for DE-06. I changed no code, because task.components assigns the implementation to TSK-01 and TSK-02 in DE-08. Where the baseline model and the override differ, I raised the difference as an open question rather than resolving it myself.

claims.text: The Invoice entity gains paid_date (date or None), which feed v3 adds; all other attributes (id, vendor, due_date, amount as Decimal 2 dp, paid) stay the same.
The organisation baseline model defines Invoice as id, vendor (str, optional), due_date, amount (Decimal, 2 dp) and paid, with no paid_date. The feature override drops 'optional' from vendor.
The ingestion layer needs no change, because csv.DictReader keys each row by the header. A v3 header carries paid_date into the row dict, and a v2 header has no paid_date key.

A paid_date that is missing, None or blank maps to None. A non-blank value that is not an ISO date rejects the row with reason 'paid_date', and paid_date is checked only after the existing fields pass.
An unpaid row with a valid paid_date is accepted and keeps the date. This is interim and depends on OQ-B6.
The data-quality report needs no code change: the new reason 'paid_date' flows into reject_reasons by itself.
The delay history is a derived, in-memory Dict[str, List[int]] computed as (paid_date - due_date).days. It covers only paid records that have a paid_date, keeps feed order and keeps negative delays.
No storage, database or schema migration is involved, and the schedule stays daily at 02:00 Asia/Kolkata.
Feed v2, with no paid_date column, still loads, and every record gets paid_date None. ap_aging ignores the extra paid_date key.
pipeline.run calls to_model on the output of parse_feed and passes the result to quality_report.
to_model converts amount with Decimal(r['amount']) and does not check the number of decimals. The transform.py docstring lists the model as (id, vendor, due_date, amount, paid).
No code was changed in this step. The model change is implemented by TSK-01 (to_model with _parse_paid_date) and TSK-02 (delays_by_vendor) in DE-08.

open_questions: DMQ-1 (non-blocking): The organisation baseline says 'vendor (str, optional)', but the feature override says 'vendor (str)'. Today the code rejects a row that has no vendor column. Which definition is authoritative? Data modeler to answer.
DMQ-2 (non-blocking): Who promotes paid_date from features/FEAT-ZD-48600/org-overrides/org.data_model.md into org/org.data_model.md after release, and when? Data engineering lead to answer.

DMQ-3 (non-blocking): The model says amount is Decimal with 2 dp, but to_model does not enforce it. This gap already exists and this feature does not change it. Should the pipeline enforce it? Data modeler to answer.
Carried CQ-DE4-1: When does feed v3 reach production? Product manager / Data engineering lead to answer.
Carried CQ-DE4-4: The inputs contain no feed v3 specification, so the column name paid_date is taken from the data model. Data modeler to confirm.
Carried OQ-B6: Should an unpaid row with a valid paid_date be accepted? The interim answer is yes. Product manager to confirm.
structured.summary: I rewrote feat.data_model_change.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The only change to the Invoice entity is one new attribute, paid_date (date or None), sourced from the optional feed v3 column of the same name. The document gives its parsing, null and reject rules, and when it is validated relative to the existing fields. It also covers the new reject reason 'paid_date', the derived in-memory delay history, a knowledge-graph view, compatibility with feed v2 and with ap_aging, and the column-to-attribute handover for DE-06. Code statements now rest only on the step's tool view, with no connector or CI-run claims. No storage or migration is needed, and no code was changed. There are no blocking questions. Three non-blocking ones are new (DMQ-1 to DMQ-3), and three are carried over (CQ-DE4-1, CQ-DE4-4, OQ-B6).
